verdict.rationale: Two of the story's three elements have first-party claims: mail is opened and scanned in company-operated facilities with access controls, and data is protected with 256-bit AES encryption and two-factor authentication. Secure storage and secure shredding are also mentioned. These are single marketing sentences, not detailed security documentation, and staff screening is never addressed. Missing for 10: staff screening/background-check documentation, detailed facility security controls, explicit confirmation that encryption covers stored scans (at rest and in transit), and independent audits or corroboration.
